decision.reason: [ev-c929ea305a6b] is only a table-of-contents line that lists "Composite resource connection details" under "Removed features", so the evidence does support the change type "removed". But it does not say what was actually removed, such as which schema fields, composition settings or mechanism. Nothing in it describes wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior family is not supported, and no other family can be picked from this line. To decide the subject, we need the body of the "#composite-resource-connection-details" section of the upgrade guide, which names the removed fields or mechanism.
